messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: EdgeLens Partnerships <partners@edgelens.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: EdgeLens pilot economics and intro verification

Hi Samantha / EdgeLens team,

Great speaking last week — excited about the potential to embed Redwood inference primitives into EdgeLens' device-side inference workflow for your pilot. Per our call, I wanted to put the commercial proposal and the partner credit mechanics in writing so we can align on a quick onboarding path.

Proposal highlights (pilot):
- 3-month pilot (non-exclusive) run on Redwood Dedicated with a capped token spend credit of $10k.
- Revenue-share on paid production after pilot: 12% of net hosting/inference revenue credited to EdgeLens for referrals for the first 12 months, tiering to 8% after $250k ARR.
- Intro/referral verification: Redwood requires the partner to register prospects in our portal prior to the first paid demo or to provide an email chain evidencing intro; credits will be honored retroactively up to 60 days from first paid invoice.
- Escrow/credit safeguard: For enterprise pilots, we propose a pilot credit escrow (locked credit applied against usage) rather than upfront refunds.

Attached: EdgeLens_Pilot_Terms.pdf (high level SOW + economics) and pilot_specs.xlsx (technical parameters + sample traffic profile).

Requests / next steps:
1) Please confirm the referral verification flow you prefer (portal registration vs email-chain + deal owner match).
2) Confirm acceptance of the credit-as-escrow approach for the pilot.
3) If agreed, we can route a short partner addendum for signatures (DocuSign) and schedule kickoff for the week of Jan 19.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa and Soojin to loop in compensation and channel ops for the revenue-share wording.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: EdgeLens_Pilot_Terms.pdf (application/pdf), pilot_specs.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear summary. We're aligned on most points; a few clarifications from our side: 

- The 12% intro credit looks fine for the pilot to start building pipeline; can we add an explicit definition for net hosting/inference revenue (i.e., gross billings less discounts and marketplace fees)?
- For verification: we prefer email-chain evidence (our AE making the initial intro) + a lightweight registration step on your partner portal. The portal requirement is a hard ask from some of our sales folks, but we can make it part of our AE checklist.
- Escrow approach: OK in principle, but we'd like the credit to be usable against early integration work (professional services) that Redwood invoices during the pilot.

I'll review the attached SOW and pilot-specs with our legal and ops and get back with any edits by EOD Wednesday. If that timeline works, let's tentatively aim for kickoff Jan 20.

Samantha
Head of Partnerships
EdgeLens

Karthik — quick internal note before we finalize wording: 

- Compensation treatment: for FY26 our channel credit plan requires earned partner credits to roll into a credits ledger that can offset invoiceable usage or be paid out after a 90-day validation window. We should be explicit whether EdgeLens can apply credits to PS invoices as they requested. If we allow PS offsets, that creates recognition complexity.
- Escrow mechanics: legal prefers a simple locked credit account on the partner ledger (not a separate trust) to avoid payment flow issues. That still meets the ask.
- Intro verification: include a clause allowing retroactive credit up to 60 days with documented proof and deal-owner confirmation from both sides; beyond that marketing ops will need to review.

Can you draft a 1-paragraph addendum to the SOW that reflects: (a) partner ledger escrow, (b) PS offset allowed up to $2,500 during pilot, (c) 60-day retroactive registration window? I'll route to ChannelOps and Finance for signoff.

-Marissa

Hi Samantha — following Marissa's internal guidance, here's the short addendum language we propose to append to the SOW. If this matches your expectations, we'll push the partner addendum to DocuSign this afternoon.

Addendum (proposed):
"Partner Credit and Intro Verification
- Redwood will establish a partner credits ledger for EdgeLens. During the pilot, Redwood will apply a $10,000 pilot credit to EdgeLens' ledger for usage and eligible professional services (PS) invoices up to $2,500. Any unused pilot credit will not be refundable but may be applied to first paid production invoices per the terms below.
- Referral credits for production are earned when (a) the referred account has a signed order with Redwood, and (b) EdgeLens is the documented introducer (via partner portal registration or email chain provided to both parties). Retroactive credit requests are allowed up to 60 days from the referred account's first paid invoice and require confirmation from both deal owners.
- Revenue-share percentages and tiering (12% first 12 months, 8% thereafter after $250k ARR) will be paid quarterly as credits on the partner ledger and are subject to Redwood's standard reimbursement and clawback policies in case of chargebacks or cancelled orders.
"

Two asks:
1) Samantha — please confirm you accept the addendum language (or suggest redlines).
2) If accepted, we'll send the addendum + SOW via DocuSign and target kickoff Jan 20.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Karthik
Head of Partner GTM
Redwood Inference
